'''Version 1.5.1''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 13th 2020.  It was 3.34 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>Fixes</u> ====

* [[Living Bow|Living Greatbow]] and [[Living Scythe]] not working as weapons
* [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Venkrol]] air mob spawning location

==== <u>Changes</u> ====

* The configuration file now shows you which mobs the Venkrol can spawn 
* Changed a description for the Living Greatbow
* Living Greatbow damage reduced from 5 to 1 by default
